components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The pet owner's optional honorific (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            prefixed to the last name to form the response-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Stored and
            returned normalized, and appended to 'addressLine1' (single space) to form 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as flat input for backward compatibility
            when no structured 'addressLine1' is supplied. Always returned as the composed,
            normalized address: 'addressLine1' with the normalized 'addressLine2' appended after a
            single space when present, otherwise the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted in national or international form
            (spaces, dashes and brackets are ignored); stored and returned in E.164 form,
            assuming country code +61 when none is supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postal code of the pet owner. Optional. When supplied it must be valid for
            the city's region using the fixed city-to-region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the
            owner's age band (see 'ageBand') as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Request-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a household with an
            existing owner. An additional owner in a household (same last name and postcode) reachable
            on a different telephone is always created; when this is true the owner is recorded as a
            declared household member rather than being flagged a possible duplicate.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical REST path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by its id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The pet owner's salutation: the 'title' honorific followed by a space and the last
                name (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the
                national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the REGION portion of its memberId, i.e. the region derived from
                the postcode (falling back to the city), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves to a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived from its locality (region) via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the locality has no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': REGION is the region code
                derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone followed by the
                last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Deterministic identifier of the owner's household: the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode, so owners with the same last
                name and postcode share it automatically. Absent for an owner without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name
                (case-insensitively) at the moment it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starting from 0, points accrue
                for each loyalty factor: +2 for an email address, +1 for no namesakes at creation
                (namesakeCount is 0), +2 for a household of 3 or more, and +3 for a tenure of more
                than one elapsed fiscal year. A newly created owner has zero tenure, so at creation
                the total cannot exceed 5.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from its membershipPoints: 1 for
                0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and 4 for 6 or more. A newly created owner has zero
                tenure, so at creation the level cannot exceed 3; level 4 requires accrued tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' when the
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' when the locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the current date,
                signalling an unusually high sign-up volume; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners, approaching the
                per-city capacity limit of 50 beyond which further owners are rejected; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'PHONE'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

## Change: `riskFlag` on the owner response

`riskFlag` is `true` when **any** of three conditions holds, else `false`:
1. the owner is a possible duplicate,
2. its email domain is disposable-adjacent,
3. its city is over its soft capacity.

I reused the existing derived signals rather than recomputing them, keeping each responsibility in its own small unit:

- **Possible duplicate** — already stored on the owner (`Owner.getPossibleDuplicate()`, set by `DetectPossibleDuplicate`).
- **Over soft capacity** — reuses the existing per-city `capacityWarning` variable (`ResolveCapacityWarning`, the 40–49 band below the hard limit of 50), which already flows to both the create and read responders.
- **Disposable-adjacent email** — a new, softer sibling of the existing disposable-domain rejection.

### Where logic landed

- **`DisposableDomains`** (new) — extracted the blocklist that was previously private inside `RejectDisposableEmail` into one shared home, with `isBlocked` (a known disposable domain → rejected outright) and `isAdjacent` (a subdomain of a blocked domain, e.g. `inbox.mailinator.com` — not blocked, but neighbouring one → risk). `RejectDisposableEmail` now delegates to it, so the two checks can't drift apart.
- **`ResolveRiskFlag`** (new) + **`@RiskFlag`** qualifier — a single small step that composes the three signals and publishes the boolean, mirroring the existing `ResolveCapacityWarning`/`ResolveBulkSignupWarning` pattern.
- **`OwnerMapper`** — added a `toOwnerDto(owner, bulkSignupWarning, capacityWarning, riskFlag)` overload layered on the existing ones.
- **Responders** — `RespondWithOwner` and `RespondWithOwnerCreated` now pass the flag through.
- **Pipelines** — `resolveRiskFlag` wired into both `owners.POST.yml` and `owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` after `resolveCapacityWarning`, so create and read responses agree.
- **`openapi.yml`** — documented the new `riskFlag` field (the `OwnerDto` is generated from it).
